Loss Types

Different Damage. Different Decisions.

Fire & Smoke

Smoke and soot can travel well beyond the source of a fire and settle into fabrics and clothing.

Water & Flood

Water can affect fibers, dyes, finishes, shape, appearance, and odor.

Soot & Residue

Visible contamination is only part of the problem. Affected textiles require careful evaluation.

Our Process

Care at Every Stage.

01

Assess

Restoration begins with understanding what happened and evaluating the affected textiles.

02

Sort

Items are organized so appropriate cleaning and handling methods can be selected.

03

Clean

Professional cleaning methods address the condition of the item while respecting its material.

04

Restore

05

Cleaning is followed by careful finishing and preparation.

06

Return

Restored clothing and textiles are prepared for return.

About American Clothing Restoration

A Specialist Has One Job: Know the Work.

American Clothing Restoration is based in Ephrata, Pennsylvania and specializes in professional garment cleaning and textile restoration associated with fire, flood, water, and property damage.

Our work sits at the intersection of garment care and property restoration. That specialization matters.

Clothing.

Our Approach

Restore First.

Replacement has its place. So does restoration. When a textile can reasonably be cleaned, restored, and returned, preserving the original item may make more sense than automatically replacing it.

No exaggerated promises. No one-size-fits-all answer. Just focused textile care aimed at achieving the best reasonable result for the item in front of us.

Frequently Asked Questions

Questions About Damaged Clothing?

24/7 inquiry availability and free pickup. Start with six common questions.

Can clothing be restored after a house fire?

Many garments affected by fire, smoke or soot can be restored. Fabric type, heat exposure and contamination determine what is practical. ACR can assess the affected items.

Can you remove smoke smells from clothing?

Professional treatments may reduce trapped smoke odors in fabrics. Results vary with the material and degree of exposure; complete odor removal cannot be guaranteed.

Can clothes damaged by flooding or a burst pipe be saved?

Many water-damaged garments and household textiles may be recoverable. The water source, time exposed and contamination affect the outcome.

Does homeowners insurance cover clothing damaged by fire or water?

Many policies cover personal belongings after qualifying losses. Coverage, deductibles and exclusions vary. Ask your insurer or adjuster about your specific claim.

How does the clothing restoration process work?

The process generally involves assessment, sorting, suitable cleaning or odor treatment, drying and inspection. Treatments depend on the condition of each item.

How do I get started, and do you offer 24/7 help and free pickup?

Yes. ACR is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for inquiries and offers free pickup. Contact ACR to describe the damage and arrange free pickup.
